# HOUSE STEEL

Pit-crew lab log for ATOM-0, a 1 kg two-wheel punching robot.
Pixel arcade twin. Teachable moves. Not LEGO. Not a humanoid this quarter.

## For agents

Do not scrape the canvas. Use the HTTP API or MCP.

- Spec: GET /api/spec
- Moves: GET /api/moves
- Get move: GET /api/moves/{id}
- Play: POST /api/moves/{id}/play
- Record start: POST /api/record/start
- Record stop: POST /api/record/stop   JSON { "name": "JAB", "frames": [...] }
- Live command: POST /api/command      JSON { "v":0, "drive":{"left":0,"right":0}, "arm":{"extend":0}, "kill":false }
- Episodes: GET /api/episodes
- OpenAPI: /openapi.yaml
- Protocol docs: /spec and docs/PROTOCOL.md
- Agent guide: docs/AGENTS.md

Protocol JSON keys: drive, arm, record, play, kill. Version 0.
Types: src/lib/protocol/types.ts
Firmware header: firmware/include/protocol.h

MCP: node mcp/server.mjs
Tools: list_moves, play_move, get_spec, get_episode

Human UI: / (pit) /lab (twin) /spec /log /crew /firmware
Kill is Space. Record 1–3 s. Name the clip. Play it back.
Seed move: JAB.

Run locally: npm run dev
Build: npm run build
